mapper.sql: v.id, v.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS uploaderNickName, v.team_id AS teamId, v.meal_type AS mealType, v.meal_date AS mealDate, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.description, v.calories, v.carbs, v.protein, v.fat, v.ai_comment AS aiComment, v.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VIDEOS (user_id, team_id, meal_type, meal_date, video_url, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{mealType}, #{mealDate}, #{videoUrl}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl WHERE vl.video_id = v.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl2 WHERE vl2.video_id = v.id AND vl2.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.team_id = #{teamId} AND v.meal_date = #{mealDate}

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl WHERE vl.video_id = v.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl2 WHERE vl2.video_id = v.id AND vl2.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE VIDEOS SET calories = #{calories}, carbs = #{carbs}, protein = #{protein}, fat = #{fat}, ai_comment = #{aiComment} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO VIDEO_LIKES (video_id, user_id) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM VIDEO_LIKES WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND user_id = #{userId}
